standard deviation of elevation in a 3 km local window

preparation: Authenticate to Earthdata before retrieving NASADEM tiles.
Download the MOLA topography raster and NASADEM tiles that intersect each declared 20 km study window.
Record source URL, retrieval timestamp, SHA-256, and native raster metadata in data/training/raw/source-checksums.json.
Clip each raster to its declared window, mask no-data values, and retain body-specific coordinate metadata.
Calculate all three feature definitions with the declared 3 km window before fitting body-specific normalisation transforms.
publicationBoundary: No raw, interim, or processed raster may enter public/; a later validated integrator handoff may create small web-demo assets.
